sdd-filesystem-search._comment_enabled: Set to true to enable semantic file search over specs and plans. Requires Node.js.
sdd-filesystem-search._comment_purpose: Provides the agent with MCP-based file system search tools, enabling richer cross-document RAG queries over large spec corpora. For most projects, the YAML front-matter traversal in rules/03-agentic-rag.md is sufficient without this server.
sdd-filesystem-search._comment_activation: To activate: set enabled=true and ensure Node.js is installed. Then restart Antigravity.
